title: Release syndication and GTM cadence for VPC RBAC, audit-logs, and KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Coordinate and deliver release collateral, training, and cross-team readiness for the VPC/On‑prem feature set that includes RBAC role mappings, centralized audit logs, and KMS integrations. This ticket owns the release-note syndication, customer pilot checklist, and the cross-functional communications schedule across Eng, Design, Support, Sales, and Legal.

Scope and deliverables:
- Consolidated release notes (public + enterprise) with safe copy for sales + support.
- Customer pilot checklist (security pre-reqs, key rotation, telemetry access).
- Internal enablement package: one-pager, demo script, recorded walkthrough, and a short technical FAQ.
- Cross-team release calendar and blackout windows for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Signed-off compliance checklist (Legal + Security) and distribution to account teams.

Stakeholders and owners:
- PM lead: Aisha Patel (creator) — overall ship and GTM decisions.
- Release owner / assignee: Diego Moreno — owns syndication, release notes, and pilot coordination.
- Eng leads: Priya Singh (runtime), Marco Huang (infra) — performance/rollback criteria.
- Design: Lena Ortiz — screenshots and console flows for docs and slides.
- Security/Compliance: Omar Khalid — KMS key policies and audit retention.
- Sales/CS enablement: Rajiv Malhotra — customer communications and pilot nominations.

Channels and artifacts:
- Confluence product brief: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/VPC-GTM-syndication (master doc)
- Release notes draft (public + enterprise): https://drive.redwood.com/Drive/Private-2026-03-ReleaseNotes.md
- Demo recording location: drive:/share/pm/vpc-demo-2026-03.mp4
- GitHub PRs for docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls?q=private-2026.03
- Slack channel for rapid questions: #pm-private-deploy (watchers: eng, design, security, sales)

Communication plan & cadence:
- Weekly cross-functional sync (Weds 10:00am PT) until GA. Agenda: blockers, docs status, pilot nominations, legal signoffs.
- Draft internal release note by 2026-03-05 for review.
- Final public and enterprise release notes signed by Legal by 2026-03-16.
- Training for Sales/CS recorded and published by 2026-03-18.

Pilot & gating criteria:
- Pilot cohorts: 3 nominated enterprise customers (security-sensitive) + 5 internal beta tenants.
- Must pass security checklist: KMS audit policy tests, RBAC mapping validation, audit-log delivery and retention test.
- Telemetry: console telemetry dashboards (latency, error-rate, key-access logs) green for 48h on staging.
- Rollback criteria: sustained error-rate > 2% on Private control-plane or failures in KMS key retrieval > 0.5% for 30 minutes.

Notes on release notes structure (required sections):
1) What’s new (high-level summary)
2) Technical details (RBAC mapping examples, KMS provider support matrix, audit-log schemas)
3) Upgrade & migration steps (customer action items)
4) Troubleshooting tips and rollback steps
5) Security/compliance considerations and retention defaults
6) Contact points and escalation path

Acceptance testing & cutover runbook:
- Eng to provide a signed-off checklist with test run IDs and dashboard links 48h before GA.
- Support to have playbooks for the top 5 customer-reported failures.
- CS to confirm pilot customer onboarding scripts are validated in a dry-run.

Open decisions / trade-offs:
- Public docs depth: do we include full audit-log schema examples or link to a separate developer appendix? (Decision pending; Product prefers short summary + appendix)
- KMS default provider: allow AWS KMS + GCP KMS at GA, HSM add-on in a later sprint (agreed tentative).
- RBAC role naming: canonicalize console role names to avoid mismatch with previous on-prem variants (ENG to provide mapping by 2026-03-08).

Next immediate tasks (owners):
- Diego: assemble first draft of enterprise release notes (due 2026-03-05).
- Lena: annotate screenshots for console RBAC flows (due 2026-03-06).
- Omar: provide compliance sign-off checklist and sample KMS policy snippet (due 2026-03-09).
- Priya/Marco: publish telemetry dashboard links and staging test results (due 2026-03-10).

Success metrics post-GA (first 30 days):
- Fewer than 2 critical support incidents attributable to RBAC/KMS onboarding.
- Pilot customers report successful key rotation and audit logs within 7 days of onboarding.
- Sales enablement NPS (internal) >= 8 for documentation clarity.
acceptance_criteria: Final public and enterprise release notes published and linked from console help
Compliance checklist signed by Security & Legal
Sales/CS enablement recorded and confirmed by Sales leadership
Pilot cohort completed on-boarding with telemetry green for 48h
Rollback and incident playbooks staged in Support runbook repository
